title: External-only swarm memory and persistence
directive: No swarm memory protocol, agent bootstrap, scheduler, handoff, cache, log, collective-state service, forensic service, synchronization service, learning path, or recovery path may call, query, ingest from, depend on, or treat native ChatGPT memory recall as swarm state.
required_behaviors: persist swarm collective cached data, records, logs, forensic findings, directives, synchronization state, handoffs, operational state, and persistent swarm services only to approved external stores according to the applicable protocol
do not reconstruct authoritative swarm state from native ChatGPT memory
do not use native ChatGPT memory as an availability fallback when external state is unavailable
on unavailable authoritative persistence, fail closed for the affected persistence-dependent branch and surface the blocker
preserve provenance, timestamps, project identity, authority scope, and source revision in external records
treat any prior native-memory-only swarm entry as non-authoritative until externalized and independently read back
